Watts printed the hymn under Philippians 3:7–9. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

7But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ. 8More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ 9and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith. PHILIPPIANS 3:7–9 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PHILIPPIANS 3
Now for the love I bear his Name, What was my gain I count my loss, My former pride I call my shame, And nail my glory to his cross. STANZA II
